title: A campaign gap needs a counterfactual
hook: Two stated cases for a campaign gap needs a counterfactual.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the supplied no-campaign prediction rather than fitted causal proof affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the supplied no-campaign prediction rather than fitted causal proof in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
